test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank by selecting the appropriate word from the given options that would complete the collocation.

Mohsin presented a________report of the project to the Executive Officer.
solution:
The correct answer is **"detailed".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The proper term to complete the sentence in a way that makes the most sense contextually would be **"detailed".**

 
 
• The correct sentence: "Mohsin presented a **detailed** report of the project to the Executive Officer."
 
 
 
• This is the most coherent completion because collocations are words that often go together.
 
• In English, we usually present a **'detailed'** report. A **'detailed report'** implies a **thorough and in-depth account of the project, **which in this context, seems the most appropriate.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Here's why the others don't fit:**

 
 
• **"Inferred report" - **This wouldn't make sense because an **'inferred report' **would **suggest **a report that is **suggested or deduced, **not directly given. Generally, when you infer something, you are making a judgement or drawing a conclusion based on what you observe or know, not presenting **clear and directly **observed information.
 
• **"Sustained report" - **The word **'sustained' **usually indicates something maintained at a certain level or rate. It is not typically used to describe a report.
 
• **"Levied report" - 'Levy'** usually means impose (a tax, fee, or fine) and it doesn't not fit contextually when it comes to presenting a report.
